missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Утро' stays in the nominative as the subject. 'Светлым' and 'тёплым' are instrumental predicate adjectives after past 'было'.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Утро' is the accusative object of 'люблю'; this neuter noun keeps the same form. 'Раннее' and 'зимнее' agree with it.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Утра' is the genitive form after 'до', expressing the time limit. 'Самого' emphasises right up to morning.
Strategic focus: Dative of time approach. 'Утру' is the dative form after 'к', expressing approach toward morning. 'Холоднее' is the comparative result.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of time. 'Утром' is the instrumental used adverbially to mean 'in the morning'. A core time expression.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of time. 'Утром' is again the instrumental meaning 'in the morning', setting when the conversation will happen. 'Об этом' names the topic.
Strategic focus: Accusative of repeated time. 'Каждое утро' uses the accusative to express a regular morning habit. 'Зарядку' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Утра' is the genitive after 'с', meaning 'since morning'. 'Сильный дождь' is the subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Утра' is the nominative plural as the subject. 'Зимние' agrees in the plural, and 'тёмные' is the predicate.
Strategic focus: Nominative in a greeting. 'Утро' is nominative in the fixed greeting 'доброе утро'. 'Доброе' agrees with it, and the question follows.
